metadata.description: Free, MIT-licensed bundles by Seaynic Labs: MCP tools plus skills, with a person approving every change.

plugins.name: bench
plugins.description: USB hardware discovery for your AI assistant: find maker boards (Arduino, ESP32, Pico), their serial ports and chips, plus skills for bring-up, serial debugging, crash decoding and safe flashing.

plugins.name: gauge
plugins.description: Your website's Umami analytics and Resend email, plus skills for weekly reports, copy, SEO and email.

plugins.name: homelab
plugins.description: Nginx Proxy Manager, Docker and Cloudflare DNS in your AI assistant, with approval for every change, plus skills for setup, exposing services, troubleshooting and health checks. By Seaynic Labs.

plugins.name: knowledge
plugins.description: Search and write your self-hosted Open Notebook from your AI assistant, plus skills for meeting notes, decision records, weekly reviews and source-backed research. By Seaynic Labs.

plugins.name: lathe
plugins.description: Local file and media tools for your AI assistant: images, PDFs, audio and video, OCR, batch runs and metadata removal, with skills for getting started, PDF output, fillable forms and web photo prep. By Seaynic Labs.

plugins.name: privacyops
plugins.description: Track credit-report disputes and draft dispute letters, kept on your own computer, with skills that walk you through each dispute. Not legal advice. By Seaynic Labs.

plugins.name: schematic
plugins.description: Diagram skills for your AI assistant: editable draw.io files, network maps, codebase maps, and animated or dark architecture diagrams. Skills only, no server. By Seaynic Labs.
